message: A few days after the match against Arakawa-senpai.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey Momimomi~, Miyako~♪<d0074> I’ve picked up the goods</d> for today~！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hey Setsugekka, could you stop calling them 'goods'？」
Setsugekka came into the room as usual.
Lately, it had become a daily routine for her to come to my room at night so we could all chat together.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eh, what's wrong with 'goods'？」

name: Momiji
message: 「It’ll be a problem if Miyako learns more weird things.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Look at you playing the big sister. We already know you’re a complete slacker, though.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Th-that’s not true, right, Miyako?」
Miyako, who had been quietly reading a book in the room, looked up.

name: Miyako
message: 「……Yeah.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, she just felt pressured to say that. Silent coercion right there.」

name: Miyako
message: 「It’s okay, big sister Momiji is reliable.」

name: Momiji
message: 「See, did you hear that？ I’m a reliable big sister.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That’s not really true, is it, Miyako?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Stop it, Setsugekka, don't confuse Miyako any further!」

name: Miyako
message: 「Could you two please keep it down? I'm trying to read.」

name: Setsugekka & Momiji
message: 「Oh, right.」
Along with Setsugekka, I quieted down.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Anyway, aside from that, I bought a bunch of snacks, so let’s all eat together.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yay~!」
Setsugekka pushed the things on the desk aside. She immediately opened the bags of snacks she’d bought.

name: Miyako
message: 「Say, Setsugekka-san, why do you always go to the convenience store for my sister？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hm？ Well, because if I don't go, Momimomi won't go.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, that’s right, I’m not going.」

name: Miyako
message: 「……You’re being used, Setsugekka-san.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「W-what did you say！？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Shhh... You don't need to say things like that!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Why you little— taking total advantage of my goodwill like that! You're not getting any of these snacks!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Whaaat, you're so stingy~!」
I answer with my cheeks stuffed full of snacks.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Honestly, you should go buy them yourself once in a while, Momimomi. Things are kinda awkward for me right now.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Huh？ What's awkward？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well, you see... whenever I go to the convenience store, I run into Sono-chan-senpai a lot.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ever since her match with you, Momimomi, she's been in a super bad mood and won't even give me the time of day when I talk to her~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sigh... I wonder if I did something to make her hate me.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hmm, I wonder.」
She treated the Suzakuin like her sworn enemies.
She's probably the anti-authoritarian, outlaw type. If so, she'd naturally view the business-aligned Kazamine Family as enemies too.

name: Momiji
message: 「Actually, what I'm wondering is how she ended up hanging out with you in the first place, Setsugekka. That's the part I really don't get~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well, both Senpai and I are huge fans of Nakamura Sakura, of course! We really connect over that!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hmm, then why not try bringing up something like that？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, right! I just need to bring up Sakura~ I'll try talking about her next time I go to the convenience store.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Thanks, Momimomi!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Don't mention it~」

name: Miyako
message: 「So Setsugekka-san is still the one going to the convenience store in the end...」
As Miyako chimes in with a pointed remark, I flash her a sly grin.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, right. Momimomi, can I ask your advice on something？」

name: Momiji
message: 「What's up~？」
I listen to Setsugekka while nibbling on snacks.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It's been right around a month since Muragaki-sensei came to the academy, so I was thinking we could give him a little thank-you to mark the occasion~」

name: Momiji
message: 「A 'thank-you' visit？ You mean we're all gonna jump him？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, yeah, a thank-you for putting us through the wringer！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Like hell that’s the case！ It’s just that typical ‘thanks for everything’ kind of thing.」

name: Momiji
message: 「You could just say that to his face, you know.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「No, that’s not it—I want us to do something with everyone in the Takamura Class.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Something with everyone, huh.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I thought about maybe baking a cake as a gift and talked to Asahi-chan and Ririmu-chan about it.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But Asahi-chan started saying she wanted to make a wedding cake, and Ririmu-chan got all obsessive over the design, so it felt like it was going to be a huge hassle, and I gave up.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh, sounds exactly like them…」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So yeah, I need an idea that won’t turn into such a pain.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「And that’s why, Momimomi, try using your Shingan no Kiwamete.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Are you an idiot? That’s not the kind of move you use for something like that!」
What does she think my ultimate technique is for?

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Fine, then don’t use it, just give me an idea~」
Honestly, what does she take me for?

name: Momiji
message: 「Hmm… well, how about an outing with everyone？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「An outing… wait, that’s it! Why didn’t I think of that!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Seriously? You should be able to come up with that on your own.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I mean, yeah, but I thought Momimomi would hate the idea, so I wasn’t sure~」

name: Momiji
message: 「Wait, I have to go too！?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well, obviously. The whole point is for the Takamura Class to thank Muragaki-sensei.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh, what a drag…」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I knew you’d say that. But since it was your suggestion, I’m dragging you along by force.」
Ugh, I got played. By someone like Setsugekka, no less.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Besides, we’ve never all gone out to hang out together, right? Don’t you think this is the perfect chance?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It’s a chance to entertain Muragaki-sensei and go out with everyone at the same time. And of course, we’ll invite Kei-chan too!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Come on, come on, doesn’t this sound like it’s shaping up to be super fun？」

name: Momiji
message: 「……Well, maybe so？」
I’ve never done anything like that—what friends usually do. I was a little bit interested, though.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Alright, then I’ll get in touch with Mr. Muragaki right away～」

name: Momiji
message: 「……Wait, hold on. Setsugekka, you have the teacher’s contact ID？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Of course! I asked him for it the other day～」
……No fair. Even I don’t have it.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, he said yes!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What about you, Miyako？ Let’s all go hang out together！」

name: Miyako
message: 「I’m okay, I want to go for a walk by myself.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Got it～ yeah, that’s fine！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Then tomorrow, let’s invite Mr. Muragaki and Momimomi too, and we’ll all go out together～！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Geez, alright then…… I’ll tag along.」
Even while thinking, 'What a hassle.'
It was also a fact that part of me was looking forward to it somewhere.
